tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[FEA8EFE747B6BFEF48AD2AB3CBEF2B13]", "D5C8FACF49D96195CBF93B8D46DCC29D", "Mayors can create Buy Orders to acquire more Settlement resources, which are critical to growth, and reward citizens for their contributions!")

NSLOCTEXT("[FEA8EFE747B6BFEF48AD2AB3CBEF2B13]", "BC7D2B7045828590F8C0BDAF0C1C443F", "Buy orders can be customized to request particular materials from citizens in order to generate specific Settlement resources. Make sure to align your buy orders with materials your citizens are likely to have.")

NSLOCTEXT("[FEA8EFE747B6BFEF48AD2AB3CBEF2B13]", "AAEAAF0A454D70FA79E846A8CC23BDCD", "Once a buy order is started, funds are automatically set aside to pay citizens for their contributions. Buy Orders can\'t be canceled so make sure you choose wisely.")
